name: Subtitle Extract Plus
description: A fork of Subtitle Extract with language filtering, forced/non-forced selection, ISO 639-1 output filenames, and optional save-with-media support.
overview: Extracts embedded subtitles with per-language and forced-track filtering.

versions.changelog:
- Per-stream ffmpeg extraction: empty forced tracks no longer cascade failures into other streams
- Skips graphical subtitles (PGS/DVDSUB) that can't be converted to SRT without OCR
